entities.summary: Rob Zettler is a Canadian former professional ice hockey defenceman and current assistant coach with the Tampa Bay Lightning of the National Hockey League. He played 14 seasons in the NHL with the Minnesota North Stars, San Jose Sharks, Philadelphia Flyers, Toronto Maple Leafs, Nashville Predators and Washington Capitals.
